summary: Tested the new coupon system + role-based admin panel end to end on the preview URL. Backend: 17 pytest cases (coupon validate math, admin coupon CRUD with persistence/expiry/reserved-prefix/duplicate checks, owner-only role management incl. promote/demote and self-demote block, non-admin 403s, create-order rejecting invalid coupons) - all 17 passed. Frontend: owner login on /account shows owner-tools with coupons-panel + admins-panel + log-hours + train-concierge; created QATEST15 (15% off, exp 2026-12-31, max 5) -> rendered as '15% off ... 0 / 5 used' and deleted successfully; super-owner badge present; promoted+demoted a second user via admins-panel UI (with correct error toast for unknown email); payment modal on /fractional-cxo: 9% launch discount on $1,290 pack -> HIA9-xxxxx code, pay button $1,173.9, savings line struck-through $1,290, remove restores $1,290; invalid promo code shows 'This code isn't valid.' toast with no discount; custom code QAUI20 (20%) on $690 pack -> $552 and launch button hidden (mutual exclusivity); non-admin user sees no owner-tools. No real Razorpay payment was initiated.

ui_bugs.issue: Money formatting drops trailing zero: shows 'Pay $1,173.9 securely' and 'you save $116.1' instead of $1,173.90 / $116.10 (money() uses maximumFractionDigits:2 without minimumFractionDigits:2 for discounted values).

integration_issues.flow: Book pack while auth state is still loading
integration_issues.issue: AuthContext initialises user=undefined (checking). PayButton.start() does `if (user) ... else setAuthOpen(true)`, so clicking a Book button before /api/auth/me resolves opens the login modal for an already-logged-in user. Reproduced once (fast click after page load); closing the modal then required a second click. Suggested fix: treat user===undefined as 'loading' (disable/spinner) instead of unauthenticated.

issues: Expiry field uses the browser-native date input (type=date, mm/dd/yyyy) rather than a styled date picker; inconsistent with the rest of the polished form styling (minor).

action_items: Fix money formatting so discounted amounts always show 2 decimals ($1,173.90, you save $116.10).
Handle the auth 'loading' state in PayButton so logged-in users are not shown the login modal on an early click.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1200 lines and mixes auth, payments, coupons, admin, chat - consider splitting into routers.
Discount is correctly recomputed server-side in /api/payments/create-order and coupon percentages are never trusted from the client - good.
used_count only increments on verify/webhook; max_uses therefore does not reserve on order creation, so a coupon could be over-redeemed under concurrent checkouts (low risk, worth noting).
